import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    cols = ["user_id", "session_num", "session_date",
            "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]

    if events.empty:
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            "user_id": pd.Series(dtype="int64"),
            "session_num": pd.Series(dtype="int64"),
            "session_date": pd.Series(dtype="object"),
            "session_start": pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[us]"),
            "session_end": pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[us]"),
            "event_count": pd.Series(dtype="int64"),
        })
        return {"user_sessions": out[cols]}

    events["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(events["event_ts"])

    # Order within user: event_ts, then event_id
    events = events.sort_values(["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"],
                                 kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    # Compute previous event ts and date within each user group
    events["prev_ts"] = events.groupby("user_id")["event_ts"].shift(1)
    events["cur_date"] = events["event_ts"].dt.date
    events["prev_date"] = events["prev_ts"].dt.date

    gap_minutes = (events["event_ts"] - events["prev_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 60.0

    is_new_session = (
        events["prev_ts"].isna()
        | (gap_minutes > 45)
        | (events["cur_date"] != events["prev_date"])
    )

    events["new_session_flag"] = is_new_session.astype(int)

    # session_num per user via cumulative sum of flags
    events["session_num"] = events.groupby("user_id")["new_session_flag"].cumsum()

    # Aggregate
    grouped = events.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"], as_index=False).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    )

    # session_date: date of the session's events (same date for all events since forced split)
    grouped["session_date"] = grouped["session_start"].dt.date

    grouped["user_id"] = grouped["user_id"].astype("int64")
    grouped["session_num"] = grouped["session_num"].astype("int64")
    grouped["event_count"] = grouped["event_count"].astype("int64")

    grouped = grouped.sort_values(["user_id", "session_num"],
                                   kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    out = grouped[cols]

    return {"user_sessions": out}
